scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite connected complete multipartite graphs and proper \(3\)-domination.
No claim is made for general proper \(p\)-domination or for algorithmic complexity on unrestricted graphs.
A poorly indexed equivalent statement under substantially different terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact proper \(3\)-domination of complete multipartite graphs
